label: Zoho connections
description: Zoho OAuth connection for this store: tokens, data center and selected organization. One record per store.

data_center.description: Zoho location code reported on the OAuth redirect, e.g. us, eu, in

accounts_server.description: Zoho accounts server of that data center, used for token exchange, refresh and revoke

api_domain.description: Zoho API domain of that data center, base for every Books and Inventory call

redirect_uri.description: Callback URL sent with the last authorize request; token calls must repeat it exactly

oauth_nonce.description: Single-use nonce of the pending authorize request

organizations.description: Zoho organizations the connected user can access

organization_currency.description: Currency of the chosen Zoho organization; amounts are sent to Zoho without conversion

location_id.description: Zoho Inventory location that receives opening stock for items the app creates

product_sync.description: Progress of the catalog sync started from the Zoho page

cursor.description: Id of the last product processed; products are walked in id order

resume_at.description: Paused until then after hitting a Zoho API limit

webhook_secret.description: Token in the webhook URLs given to Zoho

webhook_stock_sources.description: Zoho modules that have sent stock webhooks
